d: One person was killed and four others were shot and wounded after a gunman opened fire inside a gym in Washington, DC, on Thursday, November 12. The suspect then barricaded himself inside an apartment building, prompting a heavy police response across the area. Metropolitan Police Interim Chief JW Carroll said the gunman holed up inside a seventh-floor apartment, where police negotiators established dialogue. After about an hour, officers heard a gunshot and forced their way inside. They found the suspect with a self-inflicted gunshot wound. Heavily armed police officers continued…
